video.description:
These may not be the final particles for her classic skin.
Purchase RP here (Amazon Affiliate - NA): https://amzn.to/2qZ3Bmv

Her Portraits in bottom left and minimap are placeholders.

Quinn and her bird Valor, Demacia's Wings.

Abilities:
Passive - Harrier:
Valor periodically marks enemies as Vulnerable. Quinn's first attack against Vulnerable targets will deal bonus physical damage.


Q - Blinding Assault:
Valor flies in a line and strikes the first enemy in his path. He then attacks all nearby enemies to deal physical damage and blind them for X seconds. 

As Valor: Performs the same attack at the current location.


W - Heightened Senses:
Passive: Attacking a Vulnerable target will increase Quinn's Attack Speed by X% for Y seconds. 

 Passive as Valor: Gains X% Attack Speed. 

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for X seconds.


E -  Vault:
Quinn dashes to an enemy, dealing physical damage and slowing the target's Movement Speed by X% (this effect diminishes over X seconds). Upon reaching the target, she leaps off and lands near her maximum attack range from it. Valor will immediately mark this enemy as Vulnerable. 

As Valor: Performs the same attack but does not mark or leap off the target.

R - Tag Team:
First Cast: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker for X seconds. Valor gains +Y% Movement Speed, decreased gradually to +Z% when in combat. 

Second Cast: Quinn returns to perform Skystrike, dealing from X to Y physical damage to all enemies in a large area, increasing based on how much health they are missing. 

If Skystrike has not been cast before this ability ends, it will be cast automatically.
